summary: Yardbarker names a midseason (nine-game) MVP for each of the 16 AFC teams, grouped by division. Five of the picks are quarterbacks, and at least two of them should factor in the league MVP race, while Dolphins WR Tyreek Hill may be on his way to the greatest individual season ever by a receiver. Each pick is backed by stats and context from the first half of the 2023 season.
one_line: Yardbarker picks a midseason MVP for each of the 16 AFC teams, including Josh Allen, Tyreek Hill, Patrick Mahomes, Lamar Jackson and C.J. Stroud.
key_facts: Of the 16 AFC team MVPs at the midpoint, five are quarterbacks: Josh Allen, Patrick Mahomes, Lamar Jackson, Joe Burrow and C.J. Stroud.
Bills QB Josh Allen tops all QBs in QBR (75.3), is on pace for a career-high completion rate (71.3%), and accounts for 24 of Buffalo's 28 offensive touchdowns.
Dolphins WR Tyreek Hill leads the NFL in receiving yards (1,076) and TD catches (eight) and is on pace to break Calvin Johnson's season record of 1,964 receiving yards.

Jets LB Quincy Williams, the AFC Defensive Player of the Month for October, is tied for 17th in tackles (74) and tied for ninth in TFLs (nine), and is the fifth-highest-rated linebacker by Pro Football Focus.
Patriots S Jabrill Peppers has 54 tackles, one interception, one forced fumble and a team-leading six passes defended.
Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes is third in passing yards (2,442), fourth in TD passes (17) and third in QBR (73), and is favored to win his third MVP according to oddschecker.
Raiders DE Maxx Crosby has 9.5 of Las Vegas's 24 sacks and is tied for the league lead in tackles for loss (13).
Ravens QB Lamar Jackson, the 2019 NFL MVP, has thrown for 1,954 yards and nine touchdowns and rushed for 440 yards and five touchdowns during Baltimore's four-game win streak.
Browns DE Myles Garrett is tied for second in sacks (9.5), leads the league in forced fumbles (four), and leads a defense allowing the fewest yards per game (234.8).
Steelers LB T.J. Watt, the 2021 Defensive Player of the Year, is tied for second in sacks (9.5); Pittsburgh is 5-3 despite being outgained in each of its first eight games, a first in NFL history.
Texans rookie QB C.J. Stroud has 2,270 passing yards, 14 touchdown passes, a 102.9 passer rating and only one interception.
Colts RB Zack Moss rushed for 445 yards and four touchdowns in four games while Jonathan Taylor missed the first four weeks, and is second in NFL rushing, 37 yards behind Christian McCaffrey.
Jaguars RB Travis Etienne ranks third in rushing touchdowns (seven) and sixth in rushing yards (583).
Titans DT Jeffery Simmons leads the team in tackles for loss (six) and ranks second in sacks (4.5), while Tennessee's defense ranks 20th in yards allowed per game (337.8).
